svg.title: KS-07 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-07 (Close cut-in) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 0.0 to 6.5 s: A car cuts in close from the left lane. Plot: gap to the cut-in car (m). Events: cut-in starts, 10.4 m ahead (bumper to bumper) at 2.0 s; gap under 10 m at 2.3 s; cut-in car crosses into the ego lane at 3.1 s; loop ends before overlap at 6.5 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego only holds its start speed here; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench, so the loop ends before the bodies overlap. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
svg.text: A car cuts in close from the left lane
